## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status should use the same revision identifier as history: it currently truncates revisions to seven characters while history uses twelve.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, status displays `0123456` while history displays `0123456789ab`. This contradicts the status docstring’s promise to use “the same identifier as history”; `history()` explicitly slices with `revision[:12]`. Use twelve characters in status and assert the complete status output in its test. — Users receive inconsistent revision identifiers across running status and history, making deployments harder to match.
